thesis.counterargument: License timing, currency, product mix and other acquisitions can explain part of the residual; it is not direct evidence of customer deterioration.

thesis.conclusion: Broad repricing is not yet underwritable from consolidated filings.
thesis.counterargument: Eligible cohorts may have pricing headroom, but public totals do not reveal contract notice, caps, channel concessions or retention response.
thesis.next_test: Test a permissioned renewal cohort for enforceability, net realized uplift and combined churn sensitivity.

thesis.conclusion: Do not underwrite peer convergence or a second saving from the completed ShareFile transition-services exit.
thesis.counterargument: Specific avoidable costs may exist; accounting adjustments and peer ratios cannot establish the corresponding cash action.
thesis.next_test: Reconcile vendor/staff commitments, implementation spending and incremental outcomes before accepting an operating case.

options.label: Collections first (current proposal)
options.rationale: Prioritize invoice eligibility and the temporary cash mechanism before service and pricing gates.
options.challenge: Earlier collections work does not advance the assumed January collection date; service approval is delayed.

options.label: Pricing first
options.rationale: Reserve finance review for renewal eligibility first, retaining all original economic effective dates and commitments.
options.challenge: Earlier readiness does not override contract/economic start dates; service approval is pushed later.

options.label: Service first
options.rationale: Reserve service validation and acceptance first; schedule remaining finance work into available capacity.
options.challenge: Modeled advantage depends on a verifiable vendor cost action and safe service quality; freed hours alone are not earnings.

conditional_choice_reason: Among these three authored sequences, service-first restores the original base-case service start and leaves pricing and collections ready before their assumed economic dates. Prefer it only in the constructed exercise and only if the vendor cost action and quality gate can be evidenced. This is not a recommendation to deploy automation at Progress or a proof of optimality.
reopen_choice_if: No committed vendor reduction or quality-safe service mechanism: withdraw the service benefit and reforecast with committed costs retained.
Resource availability differs from the proposed budgets: re-run scheduling and reconsider the sequence.
Contract eligibility, retention response or original collection dates differ: revise the economic assumptions, not just the task order.
